title: Rightsizing recommendations and idle resource detection

videos.script: Most machines are bigger than the work they do. Some do no work at all. {{bigger}} Google's Recommender watches usage and proposes a smaller type, or a machine to stop. It is often right. It also cannot see next week's job. {{recommender}} So you will write the rule yourself, and run it on two weeks of the shop's machines. One works hard. Two would fit in half. One has done nothing for fourteen days. {{rule}} Half the machine is half the price. Deleting the idle one is cheaper still, but only after asking whose it is. {{act}} Every step before the last can be undone. That is the whole design. {{undo}}
